title: Coordinated AI triage of about 3,000 issues
summary: I coordinated engineering, architecture, infrastructure and test experts on an AI defect-triage proof of concept that triaged about 3,000 issues on live Ultrasound data.
what_would_have_happened: Test failures would keep being triaged by hand, one record at a time.
the_call: Prove triage on live data with people reviewing the AI's decisions, and settle architecture questions before building further.
what_i_did: Kept one requirements and reporting baseline for all the teams and co-wrote the architecture discovery questionnaire.
what_changed: About 3,000 issues triaged, the first sprint demo delivered and a web app pulling live test data.
